name: fifty three
source:
"Said something funny but you didn't hear me
almost said it again more clearly but it's over."
- Don't Fade Away, Beach Fossils

A friend that's one day younger, a friend you talk to very rarely. A friend that you know forever, a friend you always feel. A friend that you see as constant, a friend that sees you.

A meeting that changed something.

[From [url=https://uluutoyon.itch.io/53]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“说了句有趣的话，你却没有听见。
差点想再说一遍，说得更清楚些，但已经过去了。”
——Beach Fossils《Don't Fade Away》

一个只比你小一天的朋友，一个很少与你交谈的朋友。一个你仿佛认识了一辈子的朋友，一个你始终能感受到的朋友。一个你以为永远不会改变的朋友，一个看得见你的朋友。

一场改变了些什么的相逢。

[摘自[url=https://uluutoyon.itch.io/53]itch.io[/url]]
